prompt:
Stylised low-poly isometric fantasy game art, light-neutral.
Flat faceted shapes built from a few large flat planes with crisp hard edges, like cut paper or a clean vector illustration.
NO LIGHTING AT ALL: every material is one single flat base colour on all its facets, with no lit side, no shadow side, no highlights, no gradients and no glow; facets are shown only by a very thin, slightly darker seam where two planes meet. No outlines, no texture, no noise.
A small harmonious palette of soft, muted warm pastels (sand, terracotta, dusty rose, sage green, teal, cream, brass). No writing anywhere.
A single game sprite in classic 2:1 isometric view, looking down at about 30 degrees from one corner, standing upright, centred, with empty margin all around it.
Background: one flat solid pure magenta (#FF00FF) filling everything behind the subject,
with no floor, scenery, gradient, glow, vignette or shadow on it. No magenta anywhere in the subject.
Subject: Orb (item). Most recognisable feature: a clear glass orb with swirling light inside, on a small claw cradle. Body and shape: orb resting in a short metal cradle with a grip below. Materials: glass, silver. Colours: main pale lilac glass, secondary silver, small accent of soft white swirl. Details: plain and well made, with no owner's marks. category: off-hand. Mood: sturdy, ready.
Avoid: photorealistic, painterly, watercolour, brush strokes, anime cel shading, outlines, thick black outlines, shading, cast shadow, drop shadow, highlights, gradients, glow, texture, noise, pure black, pure white, harsh contrast, neon, lens flare, blur, top-down view, text, letters, words, labels with writing, watermark, signature, frame, border, vignette, background scenery, floor, ground shadow, cast shadow, gradient background.
